<b>Underworkers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are feeble [[Underworkers|workers]] equipped with long twistpins and hard shells which they can retreat into.<ref>Underworker [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Feeble servant of the Underworks with a long twistpin and hard shell."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Underworkers are usually found resting or walking back and forth, pausing occasionally. Once [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] is in their vicinity, they quickly walk towards her and use any of the following moves when close enough:
* <b>Swing:</b> Performs an overhead swing at Hornet with their long twistpin, stepping forward as they attack.
** Sometimes this attack has two additional hits, an upward swing followed by another overhead swing. Underworker steps forwards for the third swing, but not the second.
* <b>Retreat:</b> Moves a short distance backwards, much faster than their usual walking speed. Rarely used after missing an attack.
* <b>Shell Retreat:</b> Tucks into their hard shell, becoming immune to [[Needle]] attacks and most [[Tools]].
** They may occasionally move backwards whilst inside their shell, stopping upon reaching a ledge or wall.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-threaded]] Underworkers have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* For the light, unseen...
* These halls kept clean...
* Rest and fade...
* We... were chosen...
* See us faithful!
* Shells bend, shells break...
* Through duty, purity...
* The sacred toil...
}}

== Location ==
Underworkers can be found primarily in the [[Underworks]], with one encountered as part of the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Underworks 2|enemy gauntlet]] in the middle of the area. 

At the beginning of [[Act 3]], a [[black-threaded]] Underworker can be fought during the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Cogwork Core 2|gauntlet]] in the ruined [[Cogwork Core]].
